purpose: Single full-basin contract for PREVINE Taquari-Antas (G040): acquire meteorological data on basin+buffer, compute hydrology strictly on the basin mask, assimilate all valid hydrometric controls, and expose one basin snapshot plus distributed station diagnostics.

spatial_domain.basin_geometry_rule: unary union of all G040/Q040 polygons; this union is the hydrologic computation mask
spatial_domain.outside_basin_policy: outside-buffer data may not enter interpolation; buffer data may support interpolation/meteorological edge context but never contributes area or runoff to G040 water balance

grid_strategy.acquisition: derive a 0.1-degree grid from the G040+buffer geometry; retain cells intersecting the buffer
grid_strategy.hydrologic_weight: cell intersection area with strict G040 mask
grid_strategy.compatibility: legacy 600-cell rectangle may remain for existing HEC artifacts until migrated; it is not the canonical basin boundary

observed_precipitation.spatialization: preserve spatial field; area integrate only after clipping to G040 hydrologic units

forecast_precipitation.transition_rule: observed until the last completed observed hour; forecast afterwards; no overlap averaging

soil_state.operational_role: continuous antecedent-state estimate for the entire G040
soil_state.rule: external soil-moisture products are diagnostics/assimilation candidates, not silent replacements for internal SMA states

hydrology.domain: entire G040 from all headwaters and tributaries to the official basin outlet
hydrology.station_role: controls for observation, assimilation, calibration and validation; stations do not define model extent
hydrology.state_assimilation: use all fresh quality-controlled stage/discharge controls with documented timestamp/unit/rating-curve provenance; no visual curve shifting

standard_request.example: Como está a bacia nas próximas 24 horas?
required_steps: download/assemble antecedent observed rainfall over basin+buffer
assemble current hydrometric state across all available controls
download latest ECMWF/IFS field over basin+buffer
run distributed hydrologic models over G040
produce station/control table without treating any one station as the model endpoint

network_policy.broad_network: all stations in basin_station_status_latest.json for basin reading
network_policy.calibration_subset: quality-controlled hydro controls used for calibration/assimilation
network_policy.rule: do not confuse the number of calibration controls with the spatial extent of the basin monitoring network

validation.promotion_rule: no station or model is operationally promoted from a single event, single location or display-only fit
